jobs.name: 温玉
jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE NEW isolated paired sprite variant for an adult Chinese xianxia male portrait. The attached image is a STYLE AND SCALE REFERENCE, not a face to copy. Match its matte Chinese ink and restrained watercolour brush texture, fine organic pigment strokes, warm charcoal black and warm grey-brown colours. Strict frontal orthographic view, both organs at the same level, balanced bilateral shape, no perspective, no tilted head. Landscape canvas, one pair in a single horizontal row, ample transparent margins; preserve roughly the reference pair layout and spacing. Real transparent background, no text, no other facial features, no hair, no surrounding opaque skin or skin-coloured halo. Draw ONLY the complete two eyes, eyelid ink edges and short natural eyelashes. Warm and gentle but mature and masculine: a softly curved long almond eyelid, relaxed soft inner and outer corners, calm kind gaze, slightly curved medium-thick brows with a natural rounded arch and sparse hair tips. No drooping sorrow. Keep the eye opening and iris naturally modest, the same small eye proportion as the reference: each visible almond is about 0.60-0.65 of the distance between pupil centres, low vertical opening, iris partially covered by upper lid. Reduce exposed sclera to SMALL softly shaded ivory corner slivers and little or no lower white crescent; no broad bright white bands. Moderate warm grey-brown irises, small dark pupils, tiny equal eye catchlights. Do NOT make big round eyes or oversized irises. Keep short upper lashes and a few subtle lower lashes. No sharply pointed triangular inner corners, no heavy eyeliner, no long glamorous false lashes, no double detached lid lines, no opaque eyelid skin plate. Only the eye pair with softly faded ink edges on true transparency.
